'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC in Septimont and Chairman of the Association of Architects. He can be seen giving a speech to his apprentice, [[Galatea]] and [[Flamaxis]].
Listening in to his speech will reward the Achievement: [[Triple Walls? Triple Achievements!]].

== Idle ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Aucustus:''' Remember, you're not just plastering cement! You're building the very walls of this city!
:'''Aucustus:''' We are the Association of Architects! We are the builders of Septimont!
:'''Aucustus:''' Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:'''Flamaxis:''' Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:'''Galatea:''' Sheesh, I thought I was here for construction work. No one told me I'm supposed to be donating organs...
:'''Galatea:''' The Association of Architects is so awful...

== Dialogue ==
:'''Aucustus:''' This Wall of Morta standing before you is Septimont's first line of defense.
:{{DIcon|Option}} Listen in on the architect's speech.
::'''Aucustus:''' Over a century, four chairman of the Association of Architects devoted their lives to the Wall of Morta. Four generations, transforming it from a simple fence used to ward off animals, into a behemoth holding back the tide.
::'''Aucustus:''' The project began with the founders of the Association, later passing on to their descendants through the generations. To this day, the Association continues to perform its regular maintenance.
::'''Aucustus:''' It was here that my great-grandfather reinforced the Wall of Morta during the Second Dark Tide. He excavated the earth with the help of a Diggy Duggy from Ragunna and erected steel rods, laying the foundation for the reinforcement work.
::'''Aucustus:''' Later, the same Diggy Duggy accompanied my grandfather to drive away the Tacet Discords that were disrupting their construction work.
::'''Aucustus:''' When I first set eyes on the Wall of Morta, my father told me stories of how countless Septimont families contributed to the cause, just like we did.
::'''Aucustus:''' Whether nobleman, commoner, or Echo. In the construction of the city's future, they all had the same identity: Citizens of Septimont.
::'''Aucustus:''' As individuals, your names may become forgotten, yet through your tireless efforts, your contributions will live on forever as an integral part of Septimont!
::'''Aucustus:''' Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
